sudo mkdir -p /var/lib/secure-volume /etc/luks-keys
sudo dd if=/dev/zero of=/var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img bs=1M count=2048 status=progress 2>&1 | tail -5
sudo install -m 000 /dev/null /etc/luks-keys/secure.key
